name: F09_4
notes: Stromkirk Bloodthief. Printed: 'if an opponent lost life this turn'. Life lost by an effect counts, not only damage: seat 0's Vampire Spawn enters ('each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life': seat 0 22, seat 1 18). At seat 0's end step the counter goes on the Vampire Spawn (the chosen target), not on the Bloodthief.
